{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the column types and missing values
print(df.dtypes)
print(df['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index())

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing sentinel)
valid_ages = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute the mean
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

# Print the result
print(f'Mean age of valid customers: {mean_age}')"}
